correctness.rationale: Two independent face predicates exhaustively agree on all 4096 vertex subsets. The 723-face augmented complex has a verified acyclic 356-pair ordinary matching with critical-cell dimensions 0:1, 3:2, 4:7. Signed gradient-path elimination gives the precise two-by-seven integral boundary stated in RESULT.md, with a determinant -1 minor. As the 3-skeleton is a wedge of two 3-spheres, Hurewicz and elementary CW cancellation imply five 4-spheres. Independent full simplicial homology at primes 2,3,5 agrees. Every one of 48 graph automorphisms is enumerated, and exact signed Lefschetz sums yield the displayed complete character; averaging implies zero rational quotient reduced homology. All executable assertions were replayed from the actual packaged standalone checker. No infinite-family extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a canonical vertex-transitive cubic graph associated with Klein-bottle embeddings. The exact integral homotopy of its first nontrivial higher-independence complex is a motivated finite invariant, and the complete 48-element representation makes a substantive further distinction: a five-dimensional rational homology representation has no trivial summand, so its symmetry quotient is rationally acyclic. Neither conclusion is inferred from face counts, graph automorphism order, or generic connectivity bounds. The precise graph/cutoff and group action are intrinsic and reproducible.
